description.value:
Your gunblade chambers aetheric cartridges, tracked by the Powder Gauge. You begin each encounter with 0 cartridges, to a maximum of 3 (raised to 6 by @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-feats.Item.39542260a7548fc5]{Bloodfest}).

Building: the combo finishers @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-class.Item.b886b4f9b5e0ef3a]{Solid Barrel} and @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-feats.Item.de5ec634e0595e50]{Demon Slaughter} each load 1 cartridge.

Spending: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-feats.Item.148481d3f7d0f02b]{Burst Strike}, @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-feats.Item.bf44b0d50715c762]{Gnashing Fang}, @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-feats.Item.2d1c8118880acda4]{Fated Circle}, and @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-feats.Item.9165ace5282778b5]{Double Down} consume cartridges as noted.

A cartridge resource is added to your sheet automatically (Attributes tab).
